outcome: Distances between the distal, middle, and apical points of the upper vagina and the pubococcygeal line (PCL) and a line from the inferior pubic symphysis to the third sacral vertebra (PS3L)
Angles between the upper vagina and the PCL and PS3L
cohort: 614 hospitalized women without Pelvic Organ Prolapse or known anatomical variations (median age: 43 years, range: 17-76 years).
finding: The axis of the upper two-thirds of the vagina was found to be proximate to a line from the inferior pubic symphysis to the third sacral vertebra, especially in younger women.
